name: open the inventory
js: new Promise(r=>{const t=setInterval(()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.innerText.trim().startsWith('INVENTORY')); if(b){clearInterval(t); b.click(); r('ok')}},300)})

name: edit the first item (3D editor)
js: new Promise(r=>{const t=setInterval(()=>{const e=document.querySelector('[title="Edit item"]'); if(e){clearInterval(t); e.click(); r('ok')}},300)})
